title: Integral Tate modules have local bases after pullback
statement: Let l be a prime, X a scheme with l a unit in Gamma(X,O_X), and f:Y->X any scheme morphism. Put R_X=p_X^* continuousMapRingObj(Z_l) and T_X=lim_(r>=0) Mod.freeFunctor(R_X)(mu_(l^r)), with the l-th power transitions, exactly as in [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists]. There is a pro-etale covering (u_i:V_i->Y) such that mapMod(u_i^*) mapMod(f^*) T_X is isomorphic to the regular module over u_i^*f^*R_X. Inverse image is the actual functor of [def-sfb-finite-upper-star]. No finite-type, quasi-compactness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Displayed integral inverse limit and local rank-one sentence; the integral part of nt-target-poincare-tate-bc steps 1-3, before rational scalar extension.

proof.text: Take the local bases on X from [lem-poincare-integral-tate-local-basis]. Base-change the covering along f to a covering of Y. On each member, the pullback square gives a monoidal natural isomorphism f^* followed by the new cover restriction isomorphic to the old cover restriction followed by the map of cover members. Monoidality follows by conjugating the monoidal direct-image composition isomorphism, and equality of the two scheme composites.

Lift the monoidal comparison to linear maps explicitly: tensor naturality and naturality of the module action prove linearity; its component at R is a ring isomorphism. Restrict scalars along that component and transport the old basis through the module inverse image. The regular module maps to the regular module by the monoidal unit comparison. This gives exactly the two raw mapMod functors in the statement. All these steps are proved in Lean; there is no additional geometric pullback obligation.

proof_origin.place: Pullback of the integral local basis along arbitrary scheme morphisms, by base change of the covering and monoidal coherence.

lean.statement:
theorem tateModule_pullback_locally_trivial
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage Y, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty
        ((((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (𝒰.f i)).mapMod
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ]) X))).obj
          (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).mapMod
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ]) X)).obj
              (tateModule X ℓ))) ≅ 𝟙_ _)
